g.title: Network Canvas Studio entity-relationship diagram
g.desc: Tables and enforced foreign-key relationships generated from the assembled Drizzle schema. Sidecar-managed row-level security and triggers are attached as table tooltips.

a.xlink:title: protocols RLS policy team_isolation; sidecar forces row-level security
